scientific-plotting.agent-routing.title: Scientific plot provenance routing
scientific-plotting.agent-routing.summary: When the user asks to generate, reproduce, save, or audit a traceable scientific chart, default to a code or hybrid route through Scientific Plotting render; use model-only only when the user explicitly requests a model-owned or illustrative visual, and preserve the selected route and exact inputs so the result can be replayed by its owning worker.

workflow.description: Call visual_generate first and preserve its terminal route handoff; for chart/data provenance default to code or hybrid, while honoring an explicit model-only request.
For code or hybrid routes, map versioned files or explicit structured data into the controlled scientific plotting request.
For code or hybrid routes, render through the governed Scientific Plotting capability so the figure, recipe, manifest, and execution log are versioned together.

For model-only routes, hand off the model-owned layer to the controlled Image Generation path; its worker-owned replay receipt remains outside this panel, and Visual Review is the sole human-gated path that can accept it into Artifact Versions.
Run the governed visual review and retain its result with the rendered artifact before reporting completion.

reproducibilityRequirements: Persist the exact route decision (code, model, or hybrid).
For code or hybrid, persist versioned data, recipe, manifest, renderer environment, and execution log.

For model-only, persist the exact provider, model and version, prompt and negative prompt, generation parameters, seed when available, reference inputs, and review result in the Image Generation receipt.

Model-only output is not a formal Scientific Plot manifest; Visual Review is the sole acceptance path that may create its ArtifactVersion, whose exact ref can then be attached to the current research dossier instead of copying technical metadata.
